question: Ronak starts from Point A and drives 6 km towards the south. He then takes a left turn, drives 5 km, turns left and drives 14 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 11 km. He takes a final left turn, drives 8 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90-degree turns only unless specified.)
solution:
As per the given information:

⇒ Ronak starts from Point A and drives 6 km towards the south.

⇒ He then takes a left turn, drives 5 km, turns left and drives 14 km.

⇒ He then takes a left turn and drives 11 km.

⇒ He takes a final left turn, drives 8 km and stops at Point P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/70d13e951bda7c10bc129df03102d23144773715b050ebe1de2bc81aac4dc8f7.png] 

Point P is 6 km to the West of Point A.

Thus, to reach the starting point A from point P, Ronak must drive **6** km towards East.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
